subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat UUID-like Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source shows shared setup/auth and distinct runtime endpoints, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm whether Lite keys should route to Coding Plan only, work on both endpoints, or produce an earlier diagnostic.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement only the provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys plan-only
options.body: If Lite keys are valid only for Coding Plan, keep the endpoint split and add earlier setup or model-selection diagnostics for general-model users.

options.title: Support shared keys on both endpoints
options.body: If Lite keys should work for general models too, treat the 401 as an auth/header/runtime bug and fix that path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement only the provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses provider auth aliases, bundled-provider ownership, setup behavior, and runtime compatibility where this history is strongest.
